findings.issue: Qal sequential perfect 3ms is a finite verb; culpado is a bare passive participle (blamed), so the finite predication and qal voice are gone.
Qal perfect 3ms (completed not-knowing, no object) is smoothed to future subjunctive, the same hypothetical mood as the earlier verbs.
Qal sequential perfect of lift/carry/bear/take is narrowed to alzará (raise/lift) with his iniquity.

notes: Jehová, the אם/כי pair, feminine אחת, partitive min, and niphal 3fp on the commandments stay inside the tokens; 3fs then 3ms is the same participant.
